name: Hwa Create Corporation
summary: Hwa Create Corporation researches and develops, manufactures, and sells satellite navigation, and radar and communication products and technologies. The company provides satellite applications, radar signal processing, avionics, unmanned systems, and simulation testing. It also offers advanced devices, terminals, systems and solutions. In addition, the company provides technical support systems and safe and economical engineering solutions for users in the fields of emergency management, safety monitoring, marine fisheries, transportation, and smart cities. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
